steps.say: A skeleton is the frame of bones inside your body. An adult has about 206 bones.
Your skeleton supports you. Without it, you could not stand up.
Your skeleton protects soft organs. The skull protects your brain, and the ribs protect your heart and lungs.
Muscles pull on your bones to move them. So your skeleton helps you move.
Animals with a backbone inside, like fish, birds and cats, are vertebrates.

figure.alt: A fish, a bird and a cat, which all have a backbone.

steps.say: Insects and crabs have a hard exoskeleton outside. Worms and jellyfish have no skeleton.

figure.alt: An ant and a crab with exoskeletons, and a worm with no skeleton.
